reason: Training-free structured video prompting adds frame indices and spatial grid anchors without changing weights or decoding; tests on TemporalBench/MMSI subsets with Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B report model/task-dependent quality gains. No token, latency, or compute reduction is measured.
title: Improving Spatial-Temporal Reasoning in Video-Language Models with Structured Video Prompting
